title: Deep Sea Creatures Ranked by Size Pt.1 #shorts
description_hook: From a 12-centimeter anglerfish to a 46-meter living rope: the deep sea, ranked by size.

items.name: ANGLERFISH (FEMALE)
items.label: 12 CM
items.say: Start small. A female black seadevil anglerfish: about 12 centimeters.
items.img: a tiny black deep-sea anglerfish with a glowing lure above its mouth in total darkness, needle teeth, bioluminescent glow, macro shot

items.name: VAMPIRE SQUID
items.label: 30 CM
items.say: Vampire squid. About 30 centimeters, living 600 to 900 meters down.
items.img: a deep red vampire squid with webbed arms spread like a cloak and glowing blue eyes, drifting in black water

items.name: GIANT ISOPOD
items.label: 46 CM
items.say: Giant isopod, a pill bug's deep-sea cousin. Up to 46 centimeters.
items.img: a giant deep-sea isopod crawling over grey sediment on the ocean floor, armored segmented shell, lit by a submersible lamp

items.name: COLOSSAL SQUID
items.label: 4.2 M
items.say: Colossal squid. Only 4.2 meters, but 495 kilograms. The heaviest squid known.
items.img: a massive colossal squid with enormous eyes and thick hooked arms in the dark deep ocean, faint blue light from above

items.name: GREENLAND SHARK
items.label: 6.4 M
items.img: a huge slow Greenland shark gliding through dark icy water, pale clouded eyes, scarred grey skin

items.name: GIANT SQUID
items.label: 13 M
items.say: Giant squid. Up to 13 meters, tentacles included.
items.img: a giant squid with two very long tentacles stretched out in deep blue darkness, seen from below, eerie scale

items.name: GIANT SIPHONOPHORE
items.label: 46 M
items.say: But the longest? A giant siphonophore, about 46 meters. Longer than a blue whale, and it isn't one animal.
items.img: an extremely long glowing siphonophore colony spiraling through the black deep sea like a living rope, bioluminescent, vast

gumi.say: Gumi here. A chain of tiny clones wins. Which one scares you most?
